description: This file defines the ActivityViewModel class for an Android application, managing UI-related data and user interactions in a note-taking app. It includes methods for note operations (delete, restore, archive, pin, duplicate), preference handling, media file creation and copying, and orchestrates data flow via Kotlin coroutines and flows.

classes.name: ActivityViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing notes, preferences, media, and synchronization actions in a note-taking Android app.

methods.name: syncAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous sync operation for notes.

methods.name: deleteNotesPermanently
methods.description: Deletes specified notes permanently, cancelling reminders.

methods.name: deleteNotes
methods.description: Deletes or moves notes to bin based on user preference, cancelling reminders.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores deleted notes, showing error via toaster if failing.

methods.name: moveNotes
methods.description: Moves notes to a specified notebook.

methods.name: duplicateNotes
methods.description: Duplicates notes along with associated tags and reminders.

methods.name: setSortMethod
methods.description: Sets the method for sorting notes.

methods.name: setSortTagsMethod
methods.description: Sets the method for sorting tags.

methods.name: setSortNavdrawerNotebooksMethod
methods.description: Sets the sorting method for notebooks in navigation drawer.

methods.name: createImageFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary image file for media storage.

methods.name: copyMediaToPrivateStorage
methods.description: Copies media from a URI to private storage, returning new URI.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Applies a transform to notes and updates them.

methods.name: Array<out Note>.forEachAsync
methods.description: Executes a suspend block on each note asynchronously.
